summary: Phase C payroll frontend testing on org fa82eab8-… as accountant office@koletsas.gr for month 2026-09. Payroll panel, SEPA card, Bonus panel, Termination card and Employees table all render with correct testids. Bonus tabs + deadlines correct (xmas 2026-12-21, easter 2026-04-08). Xmas bonus payslip PDF returns 200 application/pdf. Employee-add with IBAN works and IBAN column displays. Termination flow works end-to-end: preview shows years/months/gross, save creates row + marks employee 'αποχώρησε', E6 XML returned by termination-file-<id> is valid. SEPA endpoint returns correct 400 Greek messages for missing employee IBAN and invalid debtor IBAN. HOWEVER two significant defects were found: (1) CRITICAL — /src/app/actions/staff.ts exports a non-async const STAFF_COOKIE inside a "use server" file → Next.js build error, /staff/[token] returns 500, and once the failing module is loaded the Turbopack dev overlay poisons every route (login/office/ergani all show 'Build Error'). This completely blocks the staff self-service portal AND blocks continued testing of ERGANI. (2) HIGH — After computing Easter bonus, no bonus-payslip-<id> links are rendered even though bonus-table has a row (Xmas payslip links work fine).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 9 `export const STAFF_COOKIE = "staff_portal";` inside a file that starts with `"use server";`. Next.js 16 only allows async function exports in a "use server" file. Turbopack throws a Build Error → /staff/[token] returns HTTP 500, staff-widgets.tsx fails to import staffClockAction/staffLoginAction/staffLogoutAction, /staff/[token]/page.tsx fails to import staffSession. Once triggered, the dev overlay is shown on every subsequent page load (login, office, ergani) making the whole app effectively unusable until the file is fixed. Entire staff self-service portal (PIN, clock in/out, payslips, shifts, logout, rotate) cannot be tested. Fix: move the STAFF_COOKIE constant to a separate non-server module (e.g. src/lib/services/staff-portal.ts) and import it from staff.ts and any consumer.

After clicking bonus-tab-easter then bonus-compute, bonus-table gets 1 row correctly but 0 elements matching [data-testid^="bonus-payslip-"] are rendered. Same likely for leave allowance (2 rows, links not verified but were absent in the testid dump). Xmas tab correctly renders bonus-payslip-<empId> links whose href goes to /api/office/payroll?…&month=2026-DX&kind=payslip&employee=… and returns a valid PDF (200 application/pdf, 25 KB). Fix should extend the payslip-link rendering path to easter (2026-DP) and leave (2026-LA) bonus runs.

critical_code_review_comments: src/app/actions/staff.ts: A file annotated "use server" MUST only export async functions in Next.js 15/16. Any const/let/type must be moved elsewhere. The current shape breaks the whole app in dev mode as soon as any code path pulls in the staff module. The build would also fail in production `next build`.

rca_of_the_issue: The /staff route is 100% broken because `export const STAFF_COOKIE = "staff_portal";` violates the Next.js `use server` rule — only async function exports are permitted. This causes an Ecmascript module error that Turbopack surfaces as a Build Error; downstream files that try to import from staff.ts (staff-widgets.tsx and staff/[token]/page.tsx) then fail to resolve staffLoginAction/staffLogoutAction/staffClockAction/staffSession, breaking the entire portal render. Because the error persists in the dev module graph, every page rendered afterwards in that dev process shows the error overlay. Fix (2 lines): move STAFF_COOKIE to a plain, non-'use server' module and import it into staff.ts and any consumer. Reproduction: fresh incognito → open /staff/anything → 500 Build Error overlay; refresh /login → same overlay. After fixing, `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` is optional (hot reload should clear it).
